clause: Typography determinism binding to native TextEngine [STU-TYP-008]

scope.summary: Bind 14.7 typography onto the native-Rust TextEngine (MT-018, cosmic-text/rustybuzz/swash class) behind TextEngine: Send+Sync; assert NO platform text engine (DirectWrite/Core Text/Pango) and no external/subscription shaping service at runtime ([STU-OVR-002]). Shaping, line-breaking, justification, and glyph selection MUST be deterministic given identical inputs so model-authored and operator-authored layout produce byte-identical results across hosts (promotion-equivalence requirement of 14.24). Adds the typography-side determinism + no-external-dep guard tests.
acceptance_criteria: typography bound to native TextEngine; deterministic byte-identical layout; zero platform/external shaping dep
expected_tests: live: identical inputs yield byte-identical shaped layout across two hosts/backends
test: no DirectWrite/CoreText/Pango/external shaping dependency in engine graph

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Non-deterministic or platform-bound shaping breaks promotion-equivalence + local-first mandate.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
